title: Manny Pay, Peppermint Innovation sign deal to expand QR Ph payment

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Manny Pay and Peppermint Innovation have signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) for a strategic partnership focused on expanding QR Ph digital payment solutions in the Philippines. The signing ceremony was held at the Manny Pay office in Makati City. The partnership aims to provide faster, safer, and more convenient cashless payment solutions for merchants, businesses, and consumers nationwide.
